title: NHKマイルCの後に・約束の頂点

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That was a victory worthy of an encore! Thank you for the applause! Today, I made the fans of Japan cheer, but one day in the future, it'll European fans yelling my name!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My next race is the 1,800-meter Rose Stakes! Why, you ask? Because I need to build up more stamina to run on the deep turf found in European mile races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After the Rose Stakes, I'll be running in the 2,000-meter Shuka Sho! And next year, the world! It's all coming together!
